The use of fluoronitrogen rubber not only ensures the comfort of the strap, but also makes the strap more durable. French nappa leather is usually used as the standard interior of luxury cars to bring softer color and more comfortable touch. The watch clasp adopts the needle design with OBLVLO logo, which is simple and easy to wear.
